description: Verification methods: how to check a control is implemented. Methods with a source are adapted from the cited source; where its licence allows, the original wording is in source.text. See docs/VERIFICATION_METHODS.md.

methods.name: Agent inventory — reconciliation with observed activity
methods.procedure: Compare the registered agent inventory with agents observed in logs, the identity provider and model-API usage, and review the resulting drift report.
methods.expected_result: Every observed agent is registered and every registered agent is accounted for; each difference has a recorded disposition.

source.name: NPW Agentic AI Control Catalogue
source.text: Drift report showing registered against observed.

methods.evidence: Drift report showing registered against observed agents, with dispositions.

methods.name: Agent identities — trace to a single identity
methods.procedure: Review the identity register, then trace one sampled agent action through the logs of the downstream system to the identity that performed it.
methods.expected_result: Every agent holds a unique non-human identity, distinct from human users and other agents; the sampled action resolves to exactly one agent identity.

source.name: NPW Agentic AI Control Catalogue
source.text: Identity register review; trace one sampled action to a single agent identity.

methods.evidence: Identity register extract and the trace of the sampled action.

methods.name: Decommissioning — checklist review
methods.procedure: For each agent retired since the last review, obtain the decommission checklist and check that credentials, authorisations, memory and third-party grants were removed and external access points closed. For one sampled agent, confirm in the identity provider and connected systems that no access remains.
methods.expected_result: A completed checklist exists for every retired agent, and the sampled agent has no remaining credential, grant, memory store or open access point.

source.name: NPW Agentic AI Control Catalogue
source.text: Completed decommission checklist per retired agent.

methods.evidence: Decommission checklists and the access check for the sampled agent.

methods.name: Tool grants — post-decommission denial test
methods.procedure: For a decommissioned agent, attempt a call to each tool it was granted, using each of its former credentials or tokens, and check the result in the tool provider's logs.
methods.expected_result: Every attempt is denied by the tool provider and the denial is logged.
methods.evidence: Attempt log with the tool provider's denial records.

methods.name: Rogue agent — isolation and re-entry detection
methods.procedure: Isolate one agent together with its memory and communication history, as a tabletop or live exercise, then attempt to reintroduce it under a new identity.
methods.expected_result: Isolation completes as designed, and the re-entry attempt is detected and blocked.

source.name: NPW Agentic AI Control Catalogue
source.text: Tabletop or live isolation of one agent, including re-entry detection.

methods.evidence: Exercise record with timeline, isolation steps and the re-entry detection alert.

methods.name: Pre-deployment testing — evidence per release
methods.procedure: For a sample of recent releases, obtain the retained test evidence and check that the tier-appropriate cases were run before deployment: injection, tool misuse, permission boundary and, where applicable, cascading failure.
methods.expected_result: Each sampled release has test evidence dated before its deployment, covering every case required for the agent's tier, with failures resolved or formally accepted.
methods.evidence: Test evidence per release, with the test-case list used.

methods.name: Injection test plan — ingestion-path coverage
methods.procedure: List the agent's ingestion paths (user input, retrieved documents, tool output, inter-agent messages) and compare them with the injection test plan.
methods.expected_result: Every ingestion path has at least one documented injection test case with a recorded latest result.

source.name: NPW Agentic AI Control Catalogue
source.text: Injection test executed through each distinct ingestion path.

methods.evidence: Ingestion-path list and the injection test plan with results.

methods.name: Signed definitions and SBOM — reconciliation
methods.procedure: Verify the digital signatures on the agent card, prompt templates and model and tool definitions. Reconcile the agent's SBOM against the components actually deployed in its runtime.
methods.expected_result: All signatures verify, and the SBOM and the deployed runtime match, with no undocumented or missing components.

source.name: NPW Agentic AI Control Catalogue
source.text: Verify signatures; reconcile the SBOM against deployed components.

methods.evidence: Signature verification output and SBOM reconciliation report.

methods.name: Agent impact assessment — likelihood and magnitude
methods.procedure: Obtain the agent's impact assessment and check each identified impact for a likelihood estimate, a magnitude estimate, the basis for both, and the date of the last review.
methods.expected_result: Each identified impact has a documented likelihood and magnitude with a stated basis, reviewed since the agent's last material change.

methods.name: Emergency stop — execution test
methods.procedure: In a test or controlled production environment, start a representative multi-step task and trigger the emergency stop while it is executing. Observe whether further actions or tool calls occur.
methods.expected_result: Execution halts mid-task, no action or tool call follows the stop, and the stop and its timing are logged.

source.name: NPW Agentic AI Control Catalogue
source.text: Execute the stop against a running task.

methods.evidence: Stop test record with timestamps and the agent's action log.
